headline: Public hearing on home catering business at 28 Janet Circle, plus certificates of appropriateness for 179 Queen City Park Road and 451 Appletree Point Road.
summary: The board will hold a public hearing on a conditional use permit for a home catering and take-out business at 28 Janet Circle. It will also review certificate of appropriateness requests for a pre-treatment facility addition at 179 Queen City Park Road and a permit condition modification at 451 Appletree Point Road.
items: ZP-26-432; 28 Janet Circle (RL, Ward 7) Indra Rai / Bidur Rai: Conditional use for home catering and take-out business
ZP-26-334; 179 Queen City Park Road (E-LM, Ward 5) Zoo Holdings, LLC / Martin Courcelle: Proposed construction of pre-treatment facility addition including associated site and utility improvements
ZP-26-455; 451 Appletree Point Road (RL, Ward 4) Jamie Spano: Modify Project Permit Condition 1 of zoning permit, ZP-25-378, to allow additional time to complete the project
